_comment: USD per 1M tokens for every model a turn can reach: the NS agents of the default profile and their first fallbacks, the router's BAML clients, and the Container-CC ids in router_model_class_map.json. Read by chat_nextseek/model_prices.py, which prices each model call on the day it ran. An entry's prices are tried in order and the first whose date bounds (from, until: inclusive) and prompt size (max_prompt_tokens, inclusive) fit is used. Every price names its source, the day it was checked, and whether it was read off the source (confirmed) or computed from it (derived, with how). Output prices include thinking tokens. Gemini bills cached prompt tokens at cache_read; Bedrock bills a cache write at the rate of the TTL it was asked for. A model missing here makes a turn's cost partial and is named in the turn's debug cost. A price change is an edit here plus an app rebuild.

prices.note: The text input price. Reachable only as a fallback on a box without a Bedrock token.
